answers.core: Because Spatial nodes are often times modified using position, scale and rotation rather than matrixes
answers.workaround:
for position you can use `transform.basis.origin`
for rotation you can use `rotation` or `rotation_degrees`
for scale you can use `transform.basis.scale`

but this is inconsistent and it would be nicer to have position, rotation and scale easily accessable

title: Make position and scale easily accessible
